Proposition
[Naturality of the Lie Bracket]

↗ prop:8-16

1. ch8:8.30Let $F\colon M\to N$ be smooth between manifolds, possibly with boundary. If $X_i\in \mathfrak {X}(M)$ is $F$-related to $Y_i\in \mathfrak {X}(N)$ for $i=1,2$, then $[X_1,X_2]$ is $F$-related to $[Y_1,Y_2]$.

Proof

\sketch Proposition 4 gives, for every smooth $f$ on $N$,

\[ X_1X_2(f\circ F)=(Y_1Y_2f)\circ F, \qquad X_2X_1(f\circ F)=(Y_2Y_1f)\circ F. \]

Subtracting and applying that proposition again proves the claim.

□
